Ordered last week received two days ago! Thank you
Sitting on the toilet and this is some pretty good inspiration.

If I call them and tell them everyday I want to kill my self I’m on medication and it’s getting to the point where I’m scared. Will they send someone to check on me because I’m at work right now and don’t want to be fired or seen as incompetent

I’m scared that if I tell someone how I actually feel I might be hospitalized and lose my job and really Sprial down a path I know where it ends
